Name: The Stray Catfe Returns
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
I finally got ahold of alistairweekend and got permission to release my 1.6 update for The Stray Catfe, so here it is!

[i]Meet Theo and Tabitha, a pair of twins who have just moved to the valley. Bubbly Tabitha came to Pelican Town to start a cafe with her pragmatic twin brother Theo in tow. Tabitha's go-getter attitude is inspiring, but can she really succeed on that alone? And is this really what Theo wants to do with his life? Talk to, befriend, and even romance your new neighbors to find out.[/i]

The Stray Catfe adds a new cafe south of the Bus Stop, owned and operated by a pair of twins, Tabitha and Theo. They are both romanceable, and there's included config options for the original art style or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/AirynS]AirynS[/url]'s portraits, which were included with permission. There's also a config for seasonal outfits from Wizadroid's original seasonal outfits mod (found [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18059]here[/url]) which has been integrated with permission as well. The cafe also has a fun added feature in that if you have PeacefulEnd's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8626]Custom Companions[/url] and Obamoose's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7998]Kitty Cats[/url] mods installed, it becomes a true cat cafe, with cats wandering around the property! 

This mod is compatible with SVE, RSV, and all other expansions as far as I can tell. Yri's reskin of the cafe from the old update is NOT included, as Yri is still on hiatus and I couldn't reach her for permissions for the assets.

You can find a mini-wiki [url=https://github.com/cl4r3/The-Stray-Catfe/wiki]here[/url], courtesy of ch20youk from the 1.5 update.

Enjoy!
